item.title: B.C. Appeals Court sides with First Nation over Aboriginal title on Nootka Island
item.description: VANCOUVER — The B.C. Court of Appeal has overturned a lower-court ruling after finding the judge used an "arbitrary boundary" to determine a First Nation's Aboriginal title over a swath of Nootka Island off western Vancouver Island.

item.title: Potential for Chinese EV production at Stellantis plant raises concerns
item.description: TORONTO — The prospect of U.S. automaker Stellantis using its Brampton, Ont., facility as a bare bones assembly plant for Chinese electric vehicles is being panned by Unifor and government.

item.title: After crash, Tiger Woods told deputy he was 'talking to the president,' body camera shows
item.description: After crashing his SUV last week in Florida, Tiger Woods took out his phone and told a deputy, “I was just talking to the president,” according to body camera footage released Thursday showing Woods' arrest on a DUI charge.

item.title: Canada's Jeremy Hansen rockets toward the moon with Artemis II after engine burn
item.description: CAPE CANAVERAL — Canadian Jeremy Hansen is headed toward the moon as part of the Artemis II lunar mission after a nearly six-minute engine burn to bust out of orbit Thursday evening.

item.title: Cuba releasing 2,010 prisoners as the US pressures the island's government
item.description: HAVANA (AP) — The Cuban government said Thursday it would release 2,010 prisoners in a move that comes while the Trump administration puts extreme pressure on the island's government with a suffocating oil blockade.
